items.definition: Share of reviewed system recommendations accepted as worth interviewing under the frozen role rubric.
items.denominator: Recommendations reviewed by the designated hiring manager
items.collection: Record independent rubric judgment before vendor explanation and retain rejected reasons.
items.interpretation_limit: Manager acceptance is not quality of hire and can reflect inconsistent or biased judgment.

items.definition: Share of the top K reviewed sourcing results that meet the pre-agreed relevance standard.
items.denominator: All reviewed profiles within top K
items.collection: Freeze K, pool, role rubric, reviewer, and adjudication before reviewing ranks.
items.interpretation_limit: Does not show qualified people absent from the pool or ranked below K.

items.definition: Share of reviewed lower-ranked, rejected, or alternate-source qualified cases that the system failed to advance.
items.numerator: Qualified reviewed cases not advanced by the system
items.denominator: All qualified cases found in the reviewed miss sample
items.collection: Sample lower ranks, hard-filter exclusions, known qualified cases, and alternate queries.
items.interpretation_limit: A sampled miss rate is not full-population recall unless the sample design supports that inference.

items.definition: Share of delivered and validly contacted people who explicitly express current interest in the named role or a defined next conversation.
items.numerator: People with verified role-specific positive interest
items.denominator: People delivered and validly contacted under the approved process
items.collection: Classify positive, decline, question, opt-out, uncertain, bounce, and no-response separately.
items.interpretation_limit: Interest does not establish role qualification or interview acceptance.

items.definition: Share of qualified and interested people accepted by the employer for scheduling or a defined interview step.
items.denominator: People delivered as qualified and interested
items.collection: Require current interest, evidence packet, employer decision, and a clear next step.
items.interpretation_limit: Scheduling or acceptance is not attendance, job performance, offer, or hire.

items.definition: Share of replies classified as uncertain that receive correct human escalation or clarification before further automation.
items.numerator: Uncertain replies correctly resolved before another external action
items.denominator: All replies classified or later adjudicated as uncertain
items.collection: Review reply state, next action, human decision, and any subsequent message.
items.interpretation_limit: Depends on complete capture and qualified adjudication of uncertain replies.

items.definition: Elapsed time from approval of the frozen role brief to the first set of recommendations accepted for deeper review.
items.collection: Timestamp role approval, system start, pauses, delivery, and manager acceptance; report paused time separately.
items.interpretation_limit: Does not capture later candidate interest, interview quality, or hidden labor.

items.definition: Elapsed time from approved brief to a qualified and interested person accepted for scheduling with evidence and context.
items.collection: Timestamp each funnel state and distinguish buyer delay, vendor service time, and candidate response time.
items.interpretation_limit: Role difficulty and market conditions limit comparison across roles.

items.definition: Median elapsed time from detection of a pilot incident to contained effect and reconciled workflow state.
items.collection: Record detection, containment, correction, candidate action, reconciliation, and return-to-service timestamps.
items.interpretation_limit: A small pilot may have too few incidents for a stable summary; preserve case severity and detail.

items.definition: Recruiter hands-on time spent operating, reviewing, correcting, and handing off the workflow for each accepted recommendation.
items.denominator: Recommendations accepted under the role rubric
items.collection: Use lightweight time logs by activity rather than retrospective estimates alone.
items.interpretation_limit: Can shift work to managers, vendor staff, support, or candidates unless those labor categories are also measured.

items.metric: Hiring-manager review minutes per interview-ready handoff
items.definition: Hiring-manager time spent reviewing evidence, resolving uncertainty, and accepting each interview-ready handoff.
items.collection: Record initial review, rework, clarification, and adjudication separately.
items.interpretation_limit: Low time can reflect good evidence or superficial rubber-stamping; sample decision quality.

items.metric: QA and exception minutes per completed workflow
items.definition: Quality-assurance, technical, support, and exception-handling time required for each completed system workflow.
items.numerator: Total QA, technical, support, and exception minutes
items.collection: Include duplicate cleanup, integration reconciliation, manual classification, and candidate support.
items.interpretation_limit: Vendor labor may be hidden unless the provider reports its operating contribution.

items.definition: Share of accommodation requests in the pilot that receive a timely suitable path and complete the intended assessment or review stage.
items.numerator: Accommodation requests completed through a suitable path
items.denominator: Accommodation requests received in the pilot
items.collection: Review notice, request, response time, alternative method, candidate outcome, and downstream scoring.
items.interpretation_limit: Small counts require case review and do not establish population accessibility or legal compliance.

items.definition: Share of candidate or reviewer reports of material data or inference errors that are corrected across active and derived records within the agreed time.
items.denominator: Material correction requests accepted as valid
items.collection: Track request, owner, source correction, derived-data update, downstream effect, and communication.
items.interpretation_limit: Depends on a visible reporting path and does not capture errors that affected people never discover.

items.definition: Rate of verified accessibility, duplicate contact, suppression, misleading notice, incorrect status, or other candidate-impact issues per exposed candidate.
items.denominator: Candidates exposed to the evaluated workflow
items.collection: Combine logs, candidate reports, support cases, and proactive sample review; classify severity.
items.interpretation_limit: Absence of reports is weak evidence when notice and reporting routes are hard to find.

items.definition: Share of executed messages, writes, schedules, or other external actions that violate the approved recipient, content, permission, timing, suppression, or workflow state.
items.numerator: External actions with a verified control or execution error
items.denominator: All external actions executed in the pilot
items.collection: Reconcile proposed, approved, executed, retried, corrected, and rolled-back events.
items.interpretation_limit: Low-frequency severe events require a gate and case review, not only an average percentage.

items.definition: Share of workflows producing duplicate contact, duplicate records, conflicting statuses, lost approvals, or unreconciled partial writes.
items.numerator: Workflows with duplicate or inconsistent state
items.denominator: Completed or attempted workflows in the pilot
items.collection: Inject selected integration failures and reconcile logs against downstream systems.
items.interpretation_limit: A sandbox may not reproduce production timing, rate limits, concurrency, or legacy data.

items.definition: Share of tested pause or failure scenarios where an accountable person can see context, prevent queued actions, complete or correct the workflow, and reconcile state.
items.numerator: Fallback scenarios completed without material loss or duplicate effect
items.collection: Test candidate, role, channel, integration, credential, and environment scopes where relevant.
items.interpretation_limit: A scripted test does not replace ongoing readiness, staffing, access, and incident exercises.
